## Selected conference presentations

**International Conference on Environmental Ergonomics 2026** — Kuching, Malaysia, 17–21 August 2026. Seven abstracts, including *Near-body–room air temperature difference and total sleep time in Singapore* (oral, AB59).

**Indoor Air 2026** — Singapore, June 2026. Three oral presentations, including *Bedroom nighttime temperature, humidity and sleep duration in Singapore homes*, plus a featured Project HEATS interactive workshop.

**Heat Early Warning System Symposium** — Brisbane, August 2025. *From generalised warnings to personalised guidance: synthesizing evidence to inform heat health advisory selection.*

**The Nutrition Society Congress 2024** — Belfast. Invited lecture as winner of the UK Postgraduate Competition: *Optimising dietary behaviour — can sports nutrition research contribute to improvements in population health?*
